change.description: Verify the exact last-measured H200 program; retain all original timing samples

measurement_notes: Retained measurement timings with later correctness verification of the same program and checkpoint. No deployment search or tuning was performed during verification. Phase protocols, timing samples and frozen baseline records are unchanged. AKAS uses the native engine token stream; the frozen vendor runs use HTTP/SSE. All throughput values are medians over three repetitions; decode counts the 127 outputs after the first token. Missing values remain —. † retains an incomplete or failed qualification.

efficiency_estimates.notes: MFU is the retained mixed-arithmetic useful-FLOP estimate; MBU is expected model weight plus 16-bit KV traffic divided by H200 4.8 TB/s. These are resource-model estimates, not hardware counters or guaranteed remaining speedups. Dense FP8 peak is 1,979 TFLOP/s and 16-bit peak is 989.5 TFLOP/s. The same reference model normalizes all three runtimes; native engine and HTTP delivery overhead differ.
efficiency_estimates.target_status: Prefill target 160,000 tok/s, first milestone 130,000; observed maximum 87,489 tok/s. Decode target is model MBU 50–70%; per-shape estimates are shown below.

tuning_evidence.scope: Built-in compiler search selected the retained winners; request-state copy addressing and rotary phase precision were repaired and independently qualified before timing. Execution logs are retained in [run 20261103004154703598-6dfffa42](../../runs/20261103004154703598-6dfffa42/run.json).

qualification_notes: AKAS: [verification of the exact measured program](../../runs/20261103002930485363-5b0a29c7/run.json) passed 279 operation instances (274 unique checks), all 16 retained independent BOS/chat first-token cases, and all five full-model workloads with complete 128-token output agreement and slot reuse. This qualification covers P2048 with chunk 2048. The additional [intermediate-prefill check](../../runs/20261103002207164569-1f09a073/run.json) failed a rotary tolerance; runtime phase tracing confirms that path is not executed by these measurements. Original measurement 20261103052243038756-378e9a45 and its timing samples are unchanged; its metadata records the qualification status at measurement time.
vLLM: the frozen run retains one C256 request whose greedy output changed between repetitions. All requests completed 128 tokens; the frozen timing samples are unchanged.
